system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: STABILITY NCT00799903 - The Stabilization of Atherosclerotic Plaque by Initiation of Darapladib Therapy Trial (NCT00799903)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
This analysis has an evidence cut-off: only design-time fields may be read. Results, status and enrollment fields,
and SELECT *, are rejected.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | Lp-PLA2 activity change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -65 percent | {"biomarker": "Lp-PLA2 activity", "dose": "160 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "week 12", "trial": "STABILITY NCT00799903"} | source pmcid:PMC3750980 | quote: "In the PAD group, the observed inhibition of Lp-PLA2 activity was sustained at approximately 44%, 58%, and 65% for darapladib 40, 80, and 160 mg, respectively."
c2 | Lp-PLA2 activity change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -67 percent | {"biomarker": "Lp-PLA2 activity", "dose": "160 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "week 12", "trial": "STABILITY NCT00799903"} | source pmcid:PMC3750980 | quote: "In the non-PAD group, the observed inhibition of Lp-PLA2 activity was sustained at approximately 43%, 55%, and 67% for darapladib 40, 80, and 160 mg, respectively."
c3 | hsCRP change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -13.0 % | {"biomarker": "hsCRP", "dose": "160 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "12 weeks"} | source pmid:18436114 | quote: "At 12 weeks, darapladib 160 mg decreased interleukin (IL)-6 by 12.3% (95% confidence interval [CI] -22% to -1%; p = 0.028) and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) by 13.0% (95% CI -28% to +5%; p = 0.15) compared with placebo."
c4 | IL-6 change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -12.3 % | {"biomarker": "IL-6", "dose": "160 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "12 weeks"} | source pmid:18436114 | quote: "At 12 weeks, darapladib 160 mg decreased interleukin (IL)-6 by 12.3% (95% confidence interval [CI] -22% to -1%; p = 0.028) and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) by 13.0% (95% CI -28% to +5%; p = 0.15) compared with placebo."
c5 | number of primary events | planned_events = 1500 primary end points | {} | source pmid:20934559 | quote: "The study will continue until 1,500 primary end points have occurred to achieve 90% power to detect a 15.5% reduction in the primary end point."
c6 | follow-up | median_followup = 3.51 years | {"trial": "STABILITY"} | source ctgov:NCT00799903@2013-11-12 | quote: "average of 3.51 years"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*65%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC3750980' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*67%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC3750980' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*13\\\\.0%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '18436114' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*12\\\\.3%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '18436114' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1,?500[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20934559' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "registry", "sql": "SELECT o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId = 'NCT00799903' LIMIT 5"}]}
